question: Bundelkhand and Baghelkhand are part of which physical feature of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peninsular Plateau**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bundelkhand and Baghelkhand are part of the Peninsular Plateau of India**
 
• **Bundelkhand**
 
 
• **The eastward extension of the Malwa Plateau,** Bundelkhand is a historic region in central India that is now part of the state of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It's **made up of the Vindhyan region, which is hilly and cut by ravines, and the northeastern plain. **
 
 
 
• **Baghelkhand**
 
 
• It is** Located in southern Uttar Pradesh and northern Madhya Pradesh, Baghelkhand is east of the Maikal Range.**
 
• It has an **elevation of 150–1200 meters,** and its western part is m**ade up of limestone and sandstone, while its eastern part is made up of granite. **
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Himalayan mountain range

 
 
• The Himalayas are a type of young fold mountains__.

 
 
• Fold mountains are formed due to the collision of tectonic plates.
 
 
 
• When two tectonic plates collide they get compressed resulting in the upliftment of Earth's crust.
 
• Young because the Himalayas are still in the process of formation.
 
• Includes the Himalayas, Purvanchal, and their extensions Arakan Yoma (Myanmar) and Andaman and Nicobar Islands (but we will consider these as islands only).
 
• It is the youngest and highly unstable landmass of India. [Continent – Continent Convergence]
 
• Tectonic movements are very common.
 
 
 
• **Northern Plains**
 
 
• **​**The** Northern Plains of India, also known as the Indo-Gangetic Plain**, is a fertile region in the northern and northeastern parts of the Indian subcontinent
 
• It is located **Between the Himalayas and the Deccan plateau, from the Iranian border in the west to the Brahmaputra valley in the east**
 
• **It is ****Formed by the Indus, Ganges, and Brahmaputra rivers, and the alluvial soil they deposited**
 
• The world's largest expanse of uninterrupted alluvium, perennial rivers, and rich water resources
 
 
 
• **Coastal Plains**
 
 
• **​Coastal plains are flat, low-lying areas of land that are adjacent to a sea coast. **
 
• They **are surrounded by a large body of water on one side and highlands on the other. **
 
• A fall line usually marks the border between a coastal plain and an upland area. 
 
• In India, **the coastal plains are located on either side of the Peninsular Plateau, along the western and eastern coasts. **
